learning_outcomes.text: Students learn the concepts and the general principles underlying the propagation of electromagnetic waves in transmission lines, in infinite size media (or considering media interfaces) and in standard waveguides.
Students are able to use these concepts in the future in other applications involving the propagation of electromagnetic waves.

Students should be able to understand the physical phenomena related to wave propagation and treat the associated mathematical problems in order to find solutions that should be understandable in physical terms.

syllabus_topics: Propagation of plane electromagnetic waves in media or in the presence of an interface between two materials
teaching_methods: Theoretical-practical classes with detailed presentation of concepts, principles, and fundamental theories
Solving of basic practical exercises to illustrate practical interest and exemplify application to real cases
